import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_94/training_0.csv"
]

# Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
source_dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    source_dfs.append(df)

# Since there is only one source table and its schema matches the target schema exactly,
# the transformation is straightforward: just ensure the data types match the target schema.

# Target schema: ['0': float, '1': float, '2': float, '3': float]
# Convert all columns to float
for i, df in enumerate(source_dfs):
    source_dfs[i] = df.astype({'0': float, '1': float, '2': float, '3': float})

# Union operation (concatenate) all source tables vertically
# Here only one source table, so just use it directly
target_df = pd.concat(source_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_94/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
